ledger: Scene: single continuous orbiting shot (no hard cuts) of a man in a blue suit placing/removing coins in small stainless cups with copper-colored exteriors on a red coin-decorated table; transfer material = coins.
Cup A (front-left, steel rim, copper body) 00:00-00:01.0: one gold coin lying at the bottom; hand holds a separate coin above the table.
Cup A 00:01.25-00:02.25: hand reaches into cup A and lifts a gold coin/stack out (visible removal at 00:02.25).
Cup A 00:02.5-00:03.75: appears empty inside; hand hovers/drops a gold coin at the rim repeatedly.
Cup A 00:04.5-00:09.75: hand presses a gold coin against/into cup A at the rim while camera orbits; contents not clearly visible; same shape/finish throughout.
Cup B (middle) 00:00-00:02.0: tall stack of large gold coins filling the cup nearly to the rim; top coin gold with embossed design.
Cup B 00:02.5-00:02.75: top coin still near rim but appears slightly lower; no hand contact with cup B.
Cup B 00:03.0-00:03.25: top disc now pale/silver-white and sitting below the rim; no hand contact.
Cup B 00:03.75: single gold coin visible deep inside cup, well below rim; stack no longer visible; no hand contact.
Cup B 00:04.5-00:09.75: cup appears to have only a low/empty interior from all angles; no visible removal at any point.
Cup C (back-left) 00:00-00:04.0: empty steel interior; from ~00:03.25 the second hand drops gold coins near/into it.
Cup D (right) 00:00-00:04.0: empty steel interior; untouched.
Cups C/D 00:04.5-00:09.75: back cups receive coins from the other hand; four cups remain consistent in shape, size, steel rim and copper body throughout the orbit.
Cup count: four cups at 00:00, 00:04.5, 00:07.5; arrangement shifts consistently with the orbiting camera at 00:09.0-00:09.75 (some occlusion).

findings.description: Cup B holds a tall stack of gold coins reaching nearly to the rim from 00:00 to 00:02.0. With no hand ever touching or tipping cup B, the top of the stack drops progressively (00:02.75 near rim, 00:03.25 below rim, 00:03.75 a single coin deep inside) and by 00:04.5 the cup looks essentially empty. Coins vanish from the cup with no visible removal action in a continuous shot.

The top coin in cup B is gold with an embossed design through 00:02.5, then at 00:03.0-00:03.25 the visible top disc is pale silver/white, and at 00:03.75 it is gold again but much deeper. The contents change color without any coin being added or removed.
